description: Screenshot of Q drop 2397 (Nov 3 2018) with red analyst annotations. The drop urges midterm voting, says POTUS already ordered DECLAS, that [RR] pushed back, and asks how to navigate around an installed corrupt FBI/DOJ, answering USE A STEALTH BOMBER. The annotations count eight numbered spaces under STEALTH BOMBER and eight letters in Whitaker, claiming the stealth bomber phrase decodes to Matthew Whitaker (then acting Attorney General). Filename B2.jpg references the B-2 stealth bomber.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI No.3715238 2397. Nov 3 2018 13:16:38 (EST). Keep your eye on the ball. Midterms & Memes. [—————————]. Remember, POTUS already ordered the DECLAS. [RR] pushed back hard. How do you REMOVE installed BLOCKADE? DECLAS—>DECLAS—>DECLAS. How do you navigate around installed corrupt [FBI][DOJ]? USE A STEALTH BOMBER. VOTE! VOTE! VOTE! Q. USE A STEALTH BOMBER. 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8. W h i t a k e r. <— Eight letters. <— Eight spaces.
flags: The Whitaker decode is the annotator's claim, not stated in the Q drop itself
[RR] and POTUS are the drop's shorthand, commonly read as Rod Rosenstein and President Trump

description: Screenshot of Q drop 2603 (Dec 12 2018), which quotes an earlier Q post from the same day. The quoted post links a Paul Serran tweet and a House Oversight hearing page on the Clinton Foundation, says goodbye to Mr. Rosenstein, and asks Where is HUBER (highlighted). The reply suggests another prosecutor outside of DC was assigned by Sessions with the same mandate/authority.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI ID: 48451f No.4278922 2603. Dec 12 2018 17:33:56 (EST). Q !!mG7VJxZNCI ID: 48451f No.4278743. Dec 12 2018 17:22:57 (EST). https://twitter.com/paul_serran/status/1072953304165113857. Goodbye, Mr. Rosenstein. [RR] still overseeing SC? https://oversight.house.gov/hearing/oversight-of-nonprofit-organizations-a-case-study-on-the-clinton-foundation/. Schedule for tomorrow. Where is HUBER? NOBODY IS ABOVE THE LAW. THE WORLD IS WATCHING. Q. >>4278743. What if there's another prosecutor (outside of DC) assigned by SESSIONS w/ the same mandate/authority? ONE FOR THE HISTORY BOOKS? NOT LONG NOW. Q
flags: The existence of another prosecutor with the same mandate is the drop's claim
Rosenstein, Huber and Sessions are named by the drop's shorthand ([RR], HUBER, SESSIONS), not pictured

description: Official government portrait of John Durham, then U.S. Attorney for the District of Connecticut, later special counsel investigating the origins of the Trump-Russia probe. Bald man with white beard and round wire-rimmed glasses, wearing a dark gray suit, white shirt and red-and-blue striped tie, posed before a U.S. flag and blue backdrop. This is his widely circulated official DOJ portrait.

Dusk photograph of the ornate stone facade of a building lettered BILLARD PALACE, consistent with the historic Billard Palace on Astridplein in Antwerp, Belgium (a Quick fast-food restaurant occupies the ground floor, with Menu Student and Quick deals signage visible). A Christmas light banner across the front reads MERRY Q MAS, with the middle character rendered as a letter Q in lights. Shared in Q circles as a Christmas Q proof; the ornament is a stylised X/decorative motif that reads as a Q.
text: BILLARD PALAC[E]. MERRY Q MAS. MENU STUDENT. QUICK DEALS.
flags: Antwerp location inferred from the Billard Palace name and Quick signage, not stated in the image
The Q reading of the lit character is the sharers' claim; it is a decorative X-style ornament

description: Photoshopped meme placing James Comey's face on a homeless man sitting against a storefront on a sidewalk in a sleeping bag, holding out a McDonald's cup as if panhandling. The caption WE NEVER THOUGHT SHE'D LOSE! mocks the former FBI director over Hillary Clinton's 2016 election loss, implying officials expected a Clinton win to protect them. The image is a composite, not a real photograph of Comey.
flags: Manipulated image: Comey's face composited onto another person's body
Background passersby are private individuals and remain unidentified
